messages:
Priya Menon: Heads-up 14: updating the rate/quotas guide to include the new tiered metering behavior + rate-limit interplay. Need: tiny curl + python snippets that show the v2 metering header and a fallback, plus an updated dashboard link.
Alex Chen: I can write the snippets. Keep curl minimal; python should show how to parse usage fields (tokens, meter_rate, tier_applied).
Jordan Lee: Dashboard panel moved yesterday. New link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage/consumption-tiers. Use panelId=ct-2026 for embeds. iframe example: <iframe src=\"https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage/consumption-tiers?panelId=ct-2026\" width=\"100%\" height=\"360\"></iframe>
Samir Patel: wording: change \"burst credits consumed on submit\" -> \"burst credits are applied when a request completes successfully\". Also add a line about queued requests reserving credits until completion or timeout (released on timeout).
Priya Menon: good call. We'll include a tiny events table in prose rather than a full table to keep the page readable. Example rows: request_start -> reserve 0, request_complete(success) -> deduct credits, request_timeout -> release reserved credits.
Alex Chen: Snippet draft (curl + python) coming up. Will include fallback header `x-metering-legacy` and a note about escaping quotes when copying headers into some shells.
Alex Chen: curl: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -H \"X-Redwood-Metering: {\"client_id\":\"team-9\",\"job_id\":\"j-314\"}\" -d '{"model":"rwd/fast","input":"Summarize the quota change."}'
Alex Chen: python (requests): import os, requests; headers={\"Authorization\":f\"Bearer {os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY')}\",\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"X-Redwood-Metering\":'{\"client_id\":\"team-9\",\"job_id\":\"j-314\"}'}; r=requests.post(\"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\", json={\"model\":\"rwd/fast\",\"input\":\"Summarize the quota change.\"}, headers=headers); print(r.json().get(\"usage\"))
Maria Gonzales: I'll prepare Spanish strings: \"los cre9ditos de re1faga se aplican cuando la solicitud finaliza correctamente\" and check pluralization for \"tokens\".
Priya Menon: Opening a draft PR #3601: docs/metering/tiered-metering-snippets. Assigning Alex for code, Jordan for iframe confirmation, Samir for behavior copy, Maria for L10n. DocBot: remind in 48h if no approvals.
DocBot: Reminder scheduled: will ping #docs in 48 hours if PR #3601 has no approvals. :robot_face:
Alex Chen: pushing branch now, will paste PR link here when it's up.
